thread:
alex: Proposal: launch a 6-week p99 runbook pilot with 6-8 design partners. Goal: validate automated mitigations + SLOs under real traffic. Recruiting filters: production traffic > 30 rps, willing to share anonymized trace slices, and at least one engineering contact.

trina: Love it. We should scope two cohorts: 'high-throughput' (spiky traffic) and 'steady' (consistent rps). Different measurement configs per cohort.

sam: Measurement suggestion 1: p99 measured per 1-min sliding window, then weekly 95th percentile of those minute buckets. Also collect error rate and tail CPU on the serving instance.

jen: Outreach plan: short DM + one-pager. I'll target existing customers who filed latency tickets in past 3 months. Template draft: "Hi <name> — interested in a short co-design pilot to improve p99 under your workload? 6 weeks, we provide tooling and a joint SLO. Reply with average rps and busiest hour."

sasha: Success criteria from CS angle: partner-reported impact >= 20% p99 improvement OR no negative quality regressions and commit to keep prod routing for 2+ features. Also require at least 3 scheduled feedback sessions (onboarding, midpoint, wrap).

paul: Legal ops: add opt-in telemetry clause plus retention limits (30 days) and an emergency rollback carve-out. Partners should be able to halt synthetic load runs.

alex: Runbook items to test: 1) automatic model fallback, 2) dynamic batch size cap, 3) KV cache prefill for hot prefixes. We should document expected quality delta for fallback.

ops-bot: capacity-summary: available_reserved_slots=3, estimated_slot_cost=$4k/mo. To allocate, run `/reserve slots=1 tag=p99-pilot`. Note: reserving increases isolation but reduces testing scale.

trina: UX: create a one-page partner dashboard: chosen prompt set, traffic sketch, live p99 sparkline, and 'actionable next steps' with owner tags. Keep it editable by partner.

sam: For feedback capture, require structured entries: timestamp, prompt_id, rating 1-5, subjective note, and whether synthetic/real. We'll ship a Google Sheet + minimal HTML form.

jen: Recruiting rubric idea: Commitment (0-3), Traffic match (0-4), Security posture (0-2), Product fit (0-3). Threshold 8/12. Prioritize partners who can run tests during our midday PST window.

alex: Timeline: Week 0 = onboarding + baseline, Week 1-4 = iterative tuning, Week 5 = stabilization, Week 6 = wrap + go/no-go. Deliverables: partner dashboard, weekly short writeups, final playbook.

paul: Agree. Add go/no-go criteria doc: must meet either technical improvement OR adoption metric (feature maintained in partner prod).

alex: Next steps: Jen send invites by Fri, ops to confirm slot allocation by Mon, Sam to prototype dashboard by Tue EOD. Any blockers?

trina: none from me.

jen: I'll start outreach now.
